notes: iLoveAPI (iLovePDF's developer API) gives 2,500 free credits a month after self-serve signup; it processes files rather than reading the person's iLovePDF account. Aggregators such as Composio and Zapier exist but route data through a third party; excluded.

name: Photoroom
alternative: Photoroom API with the person's own API key
notes: Official Photoroom MCP edits images through the paid API (about $0.10 per edit, small free allowance) and does not reach saved app designs. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Careem
alternative: Ride and order receipt emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: No public consumer API or MCP found for Careem rides, food or pay; only the apps. No registry entry found.

name: OnePay
alternative: Statement export (PDF/CSV) and transaction alert emails
notes: OnePay (Walmart-backed fintech) publishes no consumer API or MCP; access is app only. No registry entry found.

name: MacroFactor
alternative: The person's in-app Data Export (Quick or Granular spreadsheet)
notes: No public API; the app offers Quick and Granular data export of nutrition, weight and workouts. Registry lists only community github.com/NasserAlbusaidi/macrofactor-mcp, which reads those exports; MacroFactor is a paid subscription.

name: Misfits Market
alternative: Order and delivery emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: No public consumer API or MCP; ordering is through the website and app only. No registry entry found.

name: Chipotle
alternative: Order receipt and rewards emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: No public ordering API. The registry entry is community github.com/markswendsen-code/mcp-chipotle (npm @striderlabs/mcp-chipotle), not Chipotle's own.

name: Greenlight
alternative: Monthly statements and transaction notification emails
notes: Greenlight (kids debit card) has no public consumer API or MCP. The registry hit greenlight (ai.agentlookups) is an unrelated solar-law server.

name: FEMA
alternative: none
notes: OpenFEMA is a free read-only public-data API with no key or registration; it covers public datasets (disasters, assistance, flood), not a person's DisasterAssistance.gov case. Registry entries are community (github.com/cyanheads/fema-mcp-server, com.olyport/fema, pipeworx gateways, which route through a third party).

name: Blinkist
alternative: Highlights and reading list shared by the person manually; Send-to-Kindle is for reading only
notes: No public API or MCP found; the app offers Send-to-Kindle but no documented export. Website blocks automated fetches, so this is based on the App Store listing.

name: Volvo Cars
alternative: The person creates and publishes their own Volvo developer API application and pastes its VCC API key and client credentials, as Home Assistant documents
notes: Volvo's Connected Vehicle and Energy APIs use Volvo ID OAuth plus a VCC API key per application; owner consent is required and full credentials for a shared app are granted manually (reported 14-21 days, developer portal blocked automated fetch). Volvo-ID logins expire weekly per evcc docs.

name: Xiaomi Home
alternative: Xiaomi devices exposed through Home Assistant's official Xiaomi Home integration, or Apple Home for HomeKit-capable devices
notes: No self-serve public cloud API; Xiaomi's own Home Assistant integration (github.com/XiaoMi/ha_xiaomi_home) signs in with Xiaomi's OAuth client to MIoT Cloud, with local control through a central hub gateway. MCP servers (e.g. github.com/oujiafan/mcp-mijia) are community and use unofficial APIs.

name: BandLab
alternative: Audio and project files the person exports from BandLab to the Mac
notes: No public API or MCP found for BandLab accounts; the app offers export and sharing of tracks only. No registry entry found.

name: Mullvad VPN
alternative: Official mullvad CLI on the Mac (status, connect, relay and account commands)
notes: No documented public account API or MCP; Mullvad ships an official mullvad CLI with the desktop app that a local plugin can run. Mullvad is a paid subscription; no registry entry found.

name: IXL
alternative: Progress reports the person views or downloads from the IXL website, and IXL emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API or MCP; IXL's integrations are school rostering partnerships, not for a family account. Reports are on the website only.

name: XING
alternative: XING notification and message emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: The old XING REST API no longer accepts new applications; dev.xing.com now offers only Share and Login-with-XING plugins and partner job integrations. No registry entry found.

name: Sky
alternative: Bill and account emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: No public customer API or MCP for Sky TV, broadband or mobile accounts. Home Assistant's Sky Q box control uses an undocumented local protocol and is not a supported route.

name: Wealthsimple
alternative: Activities export (CSV) and statements from Documents in the Wealthsimple web app
notes: No public account API; community MCP servers (e.g. wealthsimple-mcp-server on mcp.so) cover only public help and promo content. The help centre documents a CSV activities export, but it blocked automated fetches.

name: PDF Expert
alternative: Read and write the person's PDF files on the Mac directly; open files in PDF Expert through its URL scheme
notes: Readdle documents keyboard shortcuts and URL schemes for opening files but no API, AppleScript dictionary or MCP. Documents are ordinary local files, so Kipster can work on them without the app.

name: The Criterion Channel
alternative: Subscription and new-programming emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP); no watchlist access
notes: Subscription streaming service with no public API or MCP; the site is geo-restricted and the apps expose no export.

name: Huckleberry
alternative: In-app data export if the person's plan offers one (unconfirmed); otherwise manual summaries
notes: No public API or MCP; logs sync only between caregivers inside the app. Any community tools rely on unofficial access or exports.

name: Zoopla
alternative: Property alert and saved-search emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: No public consumer API or MCP; the former developer API is no longer reachable (developer.zoopla.co.uk did not respond) and property data is sold to businesses. The app offers saved listings and property alerts.

name: ABCmouse
alternative: Progress emails from Age of Learning in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: Paid children's learning subscription with no public API, export or MCP.

name: Luma
alternative: none
notes: Official MCP at https://mcp.luma.com for any Luma account (no Luma Plus needed): event search, the person's events, and hosting tools. Discovery 2026-10-08: authorization server api.luma.com, DCR no, CIMD yes, S256; token auth none, client secret or private_key_jwt.

name: BBC Sport
alternative: BBC Sport RSS feeds (e.g. feeds.bbci.co.uk/sport/rss.xml)
notes: No public API or MCP for BBC accounts or personalised sport; the BBC publishes free public RSS feeds for headlines and sport sections.

name: Rocket Mortgage
alternative: Mortgage statements (PDF) the person downloads and statement emails in their mailbox
notes: No public consumer API or MCP for loan servicing; access is through the website and app. The website blocked automated fetches.

name: Uniqlo
alternative: Order confirmation and shipping emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: No public shopping or account API or MCP; the website blocked automated fetches, so this rests on the App Store listing.

name: Asana
alternative: Asana REST API with a personal access token
notes: Asana documents the V2 server at mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp; its authorization server app.asana.com advertises no registration endpoint, client secret methods only, S256, so Kipster registers one Asana app. Discovery 2026-10-08: V2 DCR no, CIMD no, S256; the older mcp.asana.com root still advertises DCR but is not the documented server.

name: Trello
alternative: none
notes: Atlassian hosts the Trello MCP at mcp.trello.com/v1 with sign-in on auth.atlassian.com. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Loom
alternative: Loom video and transcript downloads from the person's library
notes: Loom tools (videos, transcripts, comments, action items) are served by the Atlassian Rovo MCP Server, but only for Loom workspaces linked to an Atlassian site; Loom has no standalone public REST API. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Guru
alternative: Guru MCP with a user API token from Admin > API Tokens
notes: Guru hosts an MCP server with OAuth or a user API token; its help pages call OAuth pre-approved for Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT, so DCR for other clients is unconfirmed. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: ClickUp
alternative: ClickUp REST API with the person's personal API token
notes: ClickUp's hosted MCP works on every plan including Free Forever and advertises DCR, but ClickUp keeps an allowlist of vetted MCP clients, so Kipster must be added to it. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Zoho Workplace
alternative: IMAP/SMTP and CalDAV for Zoho Mail and Calendar
notes: Zoho MCP is free: the person creates their own server at mcp.zoho.com, picks Mail, Cliq and other Workplace tools, and gets a unique URL carrying an API key; Zoho authorizes the tools with OAuth 2.1 inside that server. No DCR discovery applies because the URL itself is the credential.

name: Mattermost
alternative: Mattermost REST API with a personal access token
notes: The Mattermost Agents plugin (v1.7.2+, all plans) serves an MCP endpoint at the person's own server /mcp once an admin enables external MCP access. Discovery 2026-10-08 on community.mattermost.com: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Doodle
alternative: Doodle poll and booking emails in the person's mailbox, plus the calendar Doodle syncs bookings to
notes: Doodle's help centre says it no longer supports new API use; only existing Enterprise integrations continue. No official or listed MCP found.

name: Teamwork.com
alternative: Teamwork.com API with a bearer token
notes: Teamwork.com hosts its official MCP (registry entry com.teamwork/mcp) for all paid users. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes (teamwork.com authorization server), CIMD no, S256.

name: tl;dv
alternative: none
notes: tl;dv hosts its official MCP (OAuth, no API key) on the Pro plan and above; org admins can block it. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256 (Keycloak realm keycloak.tldv.io).

name: YouCanBookMe
alternative: booking confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No official MCP; the registry lists only a third-party server (github.com/m190/usefulapi-mcp). The REST API uses HTTP Basic with the account ID and an API key the account owner generates, on the Team plan.

name: Lark
alternative: none
notes: Lark's official local MCP (beta, @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp) needs an App ID and secret from an app created in the Lark Open Platform console, with user OAuth for user-level calls. Custom apps may need tenant admin approval to publish.

name: Podio
alternative: Podio REST API with the person's own API key (client ID and secret)
notes: Progress hosts the Podio MCP server (beta) and documents shared default credentials or the person's own Podio API key. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: SmartSuite
alternative: SmartSuite open-source local MCP with an API key
notes: SmartSuite hosts its MCP at app.smartsuite.com/v1/mcp with account sign-in and no API key. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Whereby
alternative: meeting invites and room links in the person's calendar
notes: Whereby Meetings, the product people use for their own rooms, has no API or webhooks; the REST API belongs to Whereby Embedded, a separate developer product with its own accounts. No official MCP found.

name: Fibery
alternative: none
notes: Fibery hosts its MCP at mcp.fibery.io/mcp with OAuth 2.0 and no API token; the old local server is deprecated. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Chili Piper
alternative: none
notes: Chili Piper's server card lists its official MCP with OAuth or an API key; a third-party guide says sign-in needs an admin on a paid plan. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Outline
alternative: Outline MCP with an API key in the Authorization header
notes: Outline builds MCP into every workspace at https://<subdomain>.getoutline.com/mcp (self-hosted: own domain + /mcp); admins can turn it off. Discovery 2026-10-08 on app.getoutline.com: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Redmine
alternative: none
notes: Redmine is self-hosted open source; once an admin enables the REST API, each person copies their API key from /my/account. Only community MCPs exist (e.g. github.com/jztan/redmine-mcp-server).

name: Clockify
alternative: none
notes: Clockify hosts an official MCP that takes the person's self-generated API key in an x-api-key header; EU and other regions use regional URLs. No OAuth discovery needed.

name: Zoho Forms
alternative: form notification emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No Zoho Forms MCP confirmed: Zoho MCP (free, mcp.zoho.com) covers many Zoho apps, but Forms tools were not confirmed. The Zoho Forms API uses Zoho OAuth with a client registered free in the Zoho API console, no review.

name: Everhour
alternative: none
notes: Official remote MCP; Everhour docs say clients register automatically, nothing to create. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256, public clients (auth method none).

name: Hubstaff
alternative: Hubstaff public API with a registered app
notes: Official read-only MCP for owners and managers of active organizations; the exact endpoint path is not in Hubstaff docs, the host comes from its protected resource metadata. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR no, CIMD yes (account.hubstaff.com), S256.

name: 123FormBuilder
alternative: none
notes: No official MCP found. REST API v2 uses a token the person obtains from their own credentials (legacy API key in My Account); free Basic plan reportedly limited to 100 calls a day (not confirmed on a vendor page, developer pages block automated reads).

name: Twist
alternative: Twist REST API with OAuth app registration
notes: Doist's official local MCP server (@doist/twist-ai) takes the token of an integration the person creates in the Twist app console; no review. No hosted remote MCP found.

name: HubSpot
alternative: The person creates their own HubSpot user-level app or service key and supplies its credentials
notes: Remote MCP needs a pre-created HubSpot app (client secret only, no DCR); unlisted apps are capped at 25 installs until HubSpot Marketplace review. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR no, CIMD no, S256, client_secret_post only.

name: QuickBooks
alternative: QuickBooks report export (CSV/Excel)
notes: Intuit's official local MCP needs an Intuit developer app; production keys reportedly require Intuit's app assessment questionnaire and approval (not confirmed on an Intuit page). A hosted endpoint (ai-inc.quickbooks.intuit.com/v1/mcp, per third-party listings) returned 403 to discovery GETs 2026-10-08.

name: WordPress
alternative: none
notes: WordPress.com MCP needs a paid plan (free sites get the first 30 days) and must be enabled in account settings; self-hosted sites use the WordPress MCP adapter instead. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256.

name: ADP
alternative: Pay statements and tax forms downloaded from the ADP portal, or payroll report exports (CSV)
notes: No MCP and no self-serve API; integrations go through the ADP Marketplace partner programme (application and approval) and serve employers, not individual employees.

name: Meta Ads
alternative: Meta Marketing API with a registered Meta app (advanced access needs business verification)
notes: Meta-hosted ads MCP (open beta) signs in through Facebook Login for Business; owning a Meta app is not required. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes (mcp.facebook.com register endpoint), CIMD not advertised, S256, public clients; whether DCR accepts any client is untested.

name: Firebase
alternative: none
notes: Official local MCP runs through the Firebase CLI (npx firebase-tools mcp) and uses the CLI's own Google sign-in (firebase login), so Kipster passes no credentials; no hosted remote endpoint. Some tools proxy to Google remote services.

name: Okta
alternative: none
notes: Okta's official local MCP (GA) signs in with an app the admin creates in their own Okta org (device authorization or private key JWT); no project registration or review. No hosted remote endpoint.

name: Gumroad
alternative: Gumroad public API with an OAuth application
notes: Gumroad's own MCP (per-client paths /muse, /claude, /chatgpt under gumroad.com) lists products and sales, drafts and publishes products. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256 and plain.

name: Postman
alternative: Postman API key
notes: Official remote MCP (also /minimal, /code and EU host) with OAuth or a Postman API key; tool calls count toward the plan's Postman API limits. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256.

name: MongoDB Atlas
alternative: none
notes: Official local MCP uses an Atlas service account client ID and secret or a connection string the person creates. The Atlas Managed (remote) MCP uses OAuth only for AI clients MongoDB registers in advance, so it is not open to Kipster.

name: WooCommerce
alternative: WooCommerce REST API with keys the store owner creates
notes: WooCommerce MCP (developer preview) runs on the person's own store at /wp-json/mcp/mcp-adapter-default-server, signed in with a WordPress application password; needs the mcp_integration feature flag and HTTPS.

name: Dribbble
alternative: none
notes: No official MCP found. Dribbble API v2 needs a registered OAuth application with no review; terms allow commercial use but forbid automated actions not requested by the user.

name: Behance
alternative: The person's own project files, or an Adobe personal data request
notes: No official MCP (registry lists only a community scraper, Evozim/behance-portfolio-scraper-mcp); the Behance developer API page (behance.net/dev) returned 404 on 2026-10-08 and no route for new API keys was found.

name: Wave
alternative: Report and transaction exports (CSV)
notes: No official MCP found. Wave's GraphQL API reportedly uses OAuth apps registered at developer.waveapps.com; the portal blocked automated reads, so plan limits and any review are unconfirmed.

name: Clio
alternative: Clio data export (CSV/Excel)
notes: No official MCP found (community servers only). Clio Manage API access needs a developer account converted from a 7-day trial by application, and App Directory launch has requirements.

name: Webflow
alternative: none
notes: Official remote MCP; each authorization grants one workspace. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD explicitly false, S256, public clients.

name: Amplitude
alternative: none
notes: Official remote MCP for any Amplitude customer (EU: mcp.eu.amplitude.com/mcp). Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD not advertised, S256, public clients.
